title: Optimize Intel Settings
name: optimize-intel-settings
modal: This raises the dedicated VRAM segment, enables MSI mode and disables fullscreen optimizations. You can revert it here or in the Intel Graphics Command Center.
deepDescription:
This changes Intel Graphics settings for better performance:

- Dedicated VRAM segment → 512 MB
- MSI mode for the Intel GPU → On
- Fullscreen optimizations → Off
description: Changes Intel Graphics Command Center settings to improve performance
